title: It was all his fault of course ruining servants then proposing that she could eat at our table on Christmas if you please O no thank you not in my house stealing my potatoes
html_source: Molly is recalling a time when Bloom was making moves on Mary, their old servant. She is aware that Bloom may have cheated on her and therefore wishes for Mary to not spend Christmas in their house. Molly is also conscious of Bloom’s part, as he eyed this servant and planted the seeds for a possible affair.
